answer: The stake is a hostage, not a fee: 41 POA per identity, released only after 11 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 155 fakes must lock 6355 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. The anchor of the hostage is the deterrent, the knoll of the slow release is the filter, and the beacon of the burn is the punishment.
